_comment: Mutations that put the Alembic migration URL and the published
credential back the way they were.
A1: alembic/env.py hands Alembic the BARE 'postgresql://' scheme again
(the original defect). On SQLAlchemy 2.x a bare scheme resolves to
psycopg3, which is not installed, so 'alembic upgrade head' died
with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'psycopg' -- and
docker-startup.sh swallowed it, so the API served traffic while the
A2: api/database.py stops naming the sync driver (helper neutered).
A3: api/database.py strips the driver instead of naming it (the
original bug, moved into the helper).
B1: alembic.ini carries a database password again. This repository is
PUBLIC and the value is in the git history since 2026-06-08, so it
NEVER run concurrently with a test run or tools/review_fanout.py -- both will
read a file that is mid-mutation and report on code that does not exist.

mutations.label: A1: alembic/env.py hands Alembic the BARE 'postgresql://' scheme again (the original defect)
A2: the helper stops naming the sync driver
mutations.replace: return database_url  # MUTANT: the driver is never named

mutations.label: A3: the helper strips the driver instead of naming it (the original bug, moved into the helper)
mutations.replace: return database_url.replace("+asyncpg", "")  # MUTANT: the bare scheme

mutations.label: B1: alembic.ini carries a database password again
